gap_description:
No text processing/summarization, create a text_summarizer.py summarize_text - Create summary
extract_keywords - Key terms from text
count_words - Word/character count
sentiment_analysis - Positive/negative tone
Libraries: sumy, nltk, textblob
APIs: Could use LLM for summarization
purpose: Fills gap for text analysis capabilities: summarization, keyword extraction, word counting, and sentiment analysis
capabilities: Summarize text to key points (extractive summarization)
Extract important keywords and key phrases from text
Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs

parameters.operation: Operation to perform: 'summarize' for text summary, 'keywords' for keyword extraction, 'count' for word/character count, 'sentiment' for sentiment analysis
parameters.num_sentences: Number of sentences in summary (only for summarize operation)
parameters.top_n: Number of top keywords to extract (only for keywords operation)
